title: Australian Lamb Roast
description: A classic Australian dish featuring a flavorful lamb roast, perfect for a dinner gathering. This recipe is easy to make and packed with delicious flavors.

ingredients.name: Roast Vegetables
ingredients.notes: Carrots, potatoes, and onions work well

instructions: Rinse the lamb shoulder and pat dry with paper towels.
Season the lamb with salt, pepper, and rosemary.
Heat the oil in a large roasting pan over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb on all sides until browned, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the lamb to the oven and roast for 20 minutes.
Add the vegetables to the roasting pan and continue roasting for an additional 30-40 minutes, or until the lamb reaches your desired level of doneness.
Let the lamb rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
